runGroup.detail.rankExplainText:
Mi Fitness rankings rules:
1. All valid records recorded through Mi Fitness or uploaded to the app from a watch or band will be counted in the rankings.
2. Rankings statistics will be compiled by natural day, week, month, and year.
3. Workout data that is deemed suspicious won't be counted towards rankings.
4. You can join or leave the rankings. If you leave, your ranking and records won't be displayed.
5. If rankings data isn't updated when you finish a workout, make sure the above conditions have been met or check again later.
6. Only the first 200 names will be saved to rankings history.

sport.weightLossCenter.kind.reminder.des: We recommend starting with the goal of losing 3 kg in 30 days (approximately 0.5 to 0.75 kg per week). This speed allows the body to gently adapt to the changes while also fostering sustainable healthy habits. The World Health Organization recommends a safe and scientifically sound rate of 0.5 to 1 kg per week. Losing weight too quickly can lead to muscle loss and decreased metabolism, while a gradual approach is more conducive to maintaining an ideal weight over the long term. The current setting is in this healthy weight loss range.
